svg.title: Rotor circuits
svg.text: DCCREG turbine: the rotor's two circuits as built (tube, wound utrons; rotor and counter-rotor geared 1 : −1)

(a) the reluctance pump drives the AH pair · (b) the electrostatic pump's rings hold a DC field on the AH null; only C1 / C2 straddle the bodies · operating point g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm relative · only diodes switch
(a) RELUCTANCE: magnetic dual doubler → AH pair
(b) ELECTROSTATIC: de Queiroz diode doubler → DC field on the null
6 SiFe bridges per side: passive iron, no wires
B row 30° offset · radial gap 0.5 mm at r 130 mm
ROTOR · the whole circuit, no rotating contact
470 µF + SCR across La (+ to a)
stator vanes only: the reference plates of C1 / C2, no HV
joined to the shaft through one inner bearing (right)
ROTOR · the HV circuit and the core, no rotating contact
Coa, Csa, Co, Cs 100 pF · ground = the shaft
wound utrons at 0 / 120 / 240°, 200 t of Ø1.55 mm Cu: 81.0 / 9.4 mH (aligned / unaligned), 0.58 Ω each
L̂ 0.243 H, ratio κ 8.6, τ = L/R 0.140 s; Ψs 0.134 Wb-t (the 3.0 mm NiFe neck)
in 3-D: 83.3 / 12.4 mH, κ 6.70; 5.96–6.44 with the coils coupled (sim/utron-3d-findings.md)
a passing bridge closes the utron's flux path: L(θ) 6 × per rev; B row half a pitch on
anti-Helmholtz pair at the hub, one coil per branch: 160 t, 1.01 mH, 0.27 Ω each [RH]
bypass 22 mF across each coil, ESR 10 mΩ [RH] (PROPOSED)
0.146 H DC chokes: 0.87–1.15 A, ≤ 110 V, 0.29 Ω in the deck (τ 0.5 s [RH])
first cut (PROPOSED): EI-84 × 35 mm, 150 t of Ø1.40 mm, 0.126 mm gap, 0.276 Ω, 1.66 kg each
4.4 mH wiring stray, as modelled (dual of Cpar) [IR]
0.54 V at 1 A in the deck; 1.9 / 2.3 A peak; reverse 113 / 104 / 58 / 60 V with the start-up
first cut (PROPOSED): Schottky, 200 V (D1* / D2*) and 150 V (D3* / D4*), ≥ 3 A
At 1200 rpm relative (120 Hz): 0.87–2.81 A per branch, 101 V peak per group; AH 139–449 A-turns unbypassed.
With the bypass (PROPOSED): 290–308 A-turns per coil (300 mean), top and bottom within 17.
Belt 17.6 W = utron Cu 6 × 2.15 + La / Lb 0.66 + AH 2.00 + diodes 2.01 W; + iron 1.25 W = 18.8 W.
With the bypass the belt reads 18.1 W + iron 1.25 W (sim/ah-steady-cusp-findings.md).
3-D utrons: AH 221–245 A-t mean with the bypass; with the neck's field map 249–272 (sim/neck-nonlinear-findings.md).
6 + 6 vanes, 6 × 22° / 22°, 6 mm air gaps, 3 mm full rounds: 55–410 pF, κ 7.5
as built (3-D, the rims in): 128–451 pF, κ 3.51; Ca 480 pF; strays 66.2 / 24.5 pF
z 1.058 bare, 1.031 with the chains; 0.65 W (sim/tube-strays-findings.md)
451 pF (1.1 C_max): full-annulus plates, now on the rotor
HV stacks, reverse peaks 6.1 / 6.1 / 13.2 / 13.2 kV; parts not chosen
avalanche strings, BV 13.1 kV (e.g. 66 × 200 V), on the rotor: 1.07 W, 0.95 mA peak each
two rings outside the 50 mm glass: Cu foil bands 26.2–55.7°, 29.9 mm apart along it
beaded edges Ø3 / Ø2 mm (polar / equatorial) in gel, under the PEEK retainer
A: 2 CW stages on node 1, mirrored, −15.0 kV · B: 2 CW stages on node 4, +15.0 kV
100 pF storage; Dca, Dpa, Dc, Dp ≤ 7.5 kV reverse; 4 mW leakage at 100 GΩ/ring [RH]
29.9 kV across: 7.6 kV/cm, 2.6 Pa at the null (as connected; 8.2 settled)
≈ 20 pF per node [RH]; the rings 5.1 pF each to REF, 1.1 pF between
one inner bearing, for now: 0.41 mA rms AC (0.91 mA pk), no DC
At 1200 rpm relative (120 Hz): belt 2.14 W, into Z1 + Z4; z at start 1.191 (bare 1.310).
As built, real HV sticks: rings −13.38 / +13.40 kV, 6.82 kV/cm (sim/diodes-real-findings.md §6);
no self-start: a seed of 122 V on nodes 1 / 4 (1.0 kV at maximum leakage, 3.65 kV hot).
Bodies. Rotor: shaft, sleeve, rotor vanes (nodes 1 / 4), Ca / Cb plates, the 6 utrons on their carrier discs, the hub (the glass vessel with the rings outside it, the AH pair, retainer and coupler).
Counter-rotor: stator cage, stator vanes (REF), bridges. Frame: end bearings, the gear.
Not in the solids yet: La, Lb, D1*–D4*, the RC snubbers, the kick source, D1–D4, Z1 / Z4, the two CW chains, the rings (all rotor);
the record's solids (sim/tube_geometry.py --record) carry Ca / Cb on the rotor, the hub and the rings. Each pump's reaction torque goes into the gear.
(a) is the planar dual of (b) [OC]: C → L, V → I, Q → Ψ, Ca / Cb → La / Lb, Cpar → Lp2 / Lp3, D1–D4 → D1*–D4*, the clamps Z1 / Z4 → the NiFe neck's saturation.

A and B swap every half cycle: one group generates (L falling) while the other motors. Each branch carries its own side's AH coil (A below, B above; sim/magnetic_doubler.py's AHt / AHb date from when A was on top).
The AH coils: wound alike, start to x1 / x2, finish to d / b, mounted end over end with the start leads toward the vessel: anti-Helmholtz (sim/ah_winding.py).
Polarity: (b) runs negative; ring A on its own chain from node 1, negative, and ring B on the mirror chain from node 4, positive (the symmetric supply): E at the null is steady, B to A.
de Queiroz's Fig. 1 draws the core positive, all four diodes the other way (sim/queiroz_fig1_check.py).

Numbers: sim/pole_design_variants_op.json (g 0.5 / 6 bridges / 1200 rpm), sim/utron_profile.py, sim/rotor_parts_duty_results.json, sim/core_field_results.json, sim/hub_rings_build_results.json (b: the air build's capped stack)
Netlists: sim/magnetic_doubler.py, sim/core_field.py · findings: sim/pole-design-findings.md, sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md · generator: docs/make_schematic_rotor.py
